note: Hand-curated, source-cited events for nav_wrappers (2026-10-10). Trust dates: 'filing_public' is the first public conversion filing (the exchange's 19b-4 as announced, or the trust's own S-1/S-3 on EDGAR); 'listed' is the first exchange trading day (EDGAR 8-A12B / first 424B3 and the sponsor's press release). EDGAR filing dates come from data.sec.gov submissions (raw/sec/subs_<cik>.json.gz); filing texts on www.sec.gov could not be read (the archive refuses UA 'llm-quant research'), so their content is cited from press releases and news. Where sources disagree the conflict is recorded.

yahoo_unadjust.note: Yahoo's chart API scales the 'close' (not only adjclose) of GBTC before 2024-07-31 and of ETHE before 2024-07-23 by ~0.9 for the Mini Trust spin-offs. Evidence: with coin per share from XBRL, GBTC's computed discount jumps from -10.05% (2024-07-30) to -0.03% (2024-07-31) while it already traded as an ETF, and ETHE's from -11.1% (2024-07-22) to +0.15% (2024-07-23); undone with factor 0.9 (the distributed fraction of coin). Residual error about +/-0.2pp on pre-2024 discounts (the exact Yahoo factor is 1 - distribution value / prior close). Cross-check: unadjusted, GBTC's trough is -48.7% on 2022-12-13 (widely reported as about -49%).
